t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I am to try and see what colors give me the best results, and only switch colors when I see my points start dropping.

vb_textbox.text: When you start a round, try to identify the colors that give you the most points as quickly as you can. Once you have those, stick with them until your points begin to drop. At that point, switch colors. If you're having a hard time remembering which colors work best, maybe creating a little mantra or song you speak aloud will help.
